features.free_hinge_slide_joints: Implemented; compound joints add declared auxiliary inertia.
features.connect_equalities: Compliant native linear springs; impedance mapping is approximate.
features.weld_equalities: Native fixed joints; source soft weld compliance is uncalibrated.
features.static_heightfields: Source samples become a closed triangle terrain mesh; contact parity is unqualified.
features.affine_joint_and_fixed_tendon_actuators: Implemented within supported gain, bias and transmission types.
features.thread_sdf: Original visual mesh; native voxel SDF collision remains approximate.
features.textures_cameras_liquid_surfaces: Original assets and dynamic overlays retained; pixels differ.
features.capillary_flow: Opt-in laminar filled-tube flow and conservative reservoir volumes, uncalibrated.

unsupported.flexible_bodies: Native deformable state and force adapter required.
unsupported.actuator_transmission: Only joint and fixed-tendon transmissions are implemented.
unsupported.joint_actuator_gearing: Joint actuators require a unit scalar gear.
unsupported.spatial_tendon_actuators: Spatial tendon actuator forces require another adapter.
unsupported.equality_type: Only connect, weld and affine joint equalities are implemented.
unsupported.nonlinear_joint_equality: Nonlinear joint coupling requires another adapter.

scope: File/dependency discovery and GPU status; native runtime acceptance is reported separately.
